--all.help: list the information of all the files

--arch.help: Specify architecture for code size comparison. (Default is the host architecture.)

--brief.help: output only the list of issues to stdout, instead of a full report

--build-dir.help: path to Mbed TLS / TF-PSA-Crypto build directory

--check.help: Check the generated files in root

--comp-dir.help: directory where comparison result is stored. (Default: comparison)

--config.help: Specify configuration type for code size comparison. (Default is the current Mbed TLS configuration.)

--database.help: requires `--db-engine`, `--db-host`, and `--db-password` in non-interactive mode. `--db-name` and `--db-user` have defaults.

--debug.help: sets the LOG_LEVEL env variable to DEBUG

--dir.help: Directory to read entries from (default: ChangeLog.d)

--directory.help: directory where to save the backup, default is the one defined in the setting BACKUP_DIRECTORY

--expected-failures.help:
set the list of test codes which are expected to fail
                                from the command line. If omitted the list given by
                                EXPECTED_FAILURES (inside the script) is used.

--fix.help: modify source files to fix the code style (default: print diff, do not modify files)

--from.help: Start of desired validity period (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today

--keep-all-reports.help: keep all reports, even if there are no compatibility issues

--keep-entries.help: Keep the files containing entries (default: remove them if --output/-o is not specified)

--lgblock.help: Base 2 logarithm of the maximum input block size. Range is 16 to 24. If set to 0, the value will be set based on the quality. Defaults to 0.

--lgwin.help: Base 2 logarithm of the sliding window size. Range is 10 to 24. Defaults to 22.

--list-all.help: List all test cases, without doing checks

--list-files-only.help: Only list the files that would be processed (with some debugging information)

--list-for-cmake.help: List generated files in CMake-friendly format and exit

--log.help: Stream to log to (default: no logging code)

--log-file.help: Log file (default: tests/analyze_outcomes.log; empty means no log file)

--markdown.help: Show comparision of code size in a markdown table. (Only show the files that have changed).

--mbedtls-root.help: root directory of mbedtls source code

--method.help: The method that is used to save the config

--mode.help: The compression mode can be 0 for generic input, 1 for UTF-8 encoded text, or 2 for WOFF 2.0 font data. Defaults to 0.

--new-rev.help: new Git revision as comparison base. (Default is the current work directory, including uncommitted changes.)

--no-act.help: Don't act, just print what will be done

--no-check-changes.help: Set the changes to checked in the database

--no-keep-entries.help: Remove the files containing entries after they are merged (default: remove them if --output/-o is not specified)

--no-tls12-client-hello-defragmentation-.help: Whether the TLS 1.2 ClientHello defragmentation is fully supported or not (default: True)

--out-dir.help: Dir where generated code and scripts are copied

--patch-directory.help: Directory containing patches (*.patch) to apply to psa-arch-tests

--pip-install-option.help: Pass this option to pip install

--pip-option.help: Pass this general option to pip

--prefix.help: sets a prefix for the resulting regex

--project-root.help: root directory of repo source code

--quality.help: Controls the compression-speed vs compression-density tradeoff. The higher the quality, the slower the compression. Range is 0 to 11. Defaults to 11.

--quiet.help: hide unnecessary text, explanations, and highlights

--record-dir.help: directory where code size record is stored. (Default: code_size_records)

--report-dir.help: directory where reports are stored, default is reports

--root.help: Root of the tree containing the generated files                               to check (default: Mbed TLS or TF-PSA-Cryto root.)

--show-all.help: Show all the objects in comparison result, including the ones that haven't changed in code size. (Default: False)

--since.help: only check files modified since the specified commit (e.g. --since=HEAD~3 or --since=development). If no commit is specified, default to development.

--skip-file.help: path to file containing symbols and types to skip (typically "-s identifiers" after running "tests/scripts/list-identifiers.sh --internal")

--stdout.help: Set this option to direct comparison result into sys.stdout. (Default: file)

--subset.help: only check the specified files (default with non-option arguments)

--suffix.help: sets a suffix for the resulting regex

--tags-list.help: Path to file with permitted tags

--target.help: where nginx will search for configurations files

--templates.help: directory containing the main template files

--to.help: End of desired validity period (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD). Default: --from

--user.help: Install to the Python user install directory (short for --pip-install-option --user)

--variables.help: path to the file containing environment variables

--verbose.help: Show logs in detail for code size measurement. (Default: False)

--write.help: File to write to instead of the input file.

-service.help: service that triggered the ban (default: bwcli). If specified with a valid service name, ban will be service-specific

backup_file.help: backup file to restore (default : latest backup)

ban.help: add a ban to the cache

client.help: Choose TLS client program for test

command.help: the command to execute on the plugin

get.help:
Find the value of SYMBOL and print it. Exit with
                 status 0 if a #define for SYMBOL is found, 1 otherwise.

get-all.help: Get all #define whose name contains a match for REGEX.

get-all-enabled.help: Get all enabled #define whose name contains a match for REGEX.

idents.help: List of generator names or targets (all targets if empty)

operands.help: files to check (files MUST be known to git, if none: check all)

outcomes.help: Outcome file to analyze (can be .gz or .xz)

plugin.help: execute a custom command from a plugin

plugin_command.help: the command to execute on the plugin

plugin_id.help: the plugin id that you want to execute the command on

plugin_list.help: list all available plugins and their commands

server.help: Choose TLS server program for test

set.help:
Set SYMBOL to VALUE. If VALUE is omitted, just uncomment
                 the #define for SYMBOL. Error out of a line defining
                 SYMBOL (commented or not) is not found, unless --force is passed.

set-all.help: Uncomment all #define whose name contains a match for REGEX.

specified_tasks.help: Analysis to be done. By default, run all tasks. With one or more TASK, run only those. TASK can be the name of a single task or comma/space-separated list of tasks.

strings.help: the strings to convert into a negative lookahead

unban.help: remove a ban from the cache

unset.help: Comment out the #define for SYMBOL. Do nothing if none is present.

unset-all.help: Comment out all #define whose name contains a match for REGEX.
